requirements.statement: Every link of the site map is up to date and leads to the page its text names.

citations.quote: Les liens du plan du site renvoient-ils bien vers les pages indiquées par l’intitulé ?

routes.statement: Each link is neither obsolete nor in error, and leads to the page indicated by its text.

citations.quote: vérifier qu’ils sont à jour (ni obsolètes ni en erreur) et conduisent à la page indiquée par leur intitulé ;

rationale.text: Whether a link leads to the page its text names is judgment: someone must read the link's text and the page it reaches and decide that they match. Whether a link is obsolete is judgment too. Even the error case needs the link's target to be requested, which is outside what a check may do on a rendered page. Which page is the site map page is established by the human. No axe rule is tagged and no custom check is registered. The entry is none. Applicability is judgment: the test applies only on the site map page, and a site without one makes it not applicable. Needs is empty: the pages reached are other pages, which no prerequisite covers.

citations.quote: Pour tous les liens du plan du site, vérifier qu’ils sont à jour (ni obsolètes ni en erreur) et conduisent à la page indiquée par leur intitulé ;
La page « plan du site » est-elle pertinente ?
